name: Avatar (Fast)
description: Wan 2.2 S2V 14B with the 4-step LightX2V speed-up. Pick a face photo and a voice file. Makes a talking video with lip sync, with the voice as its sound. 640 x 640, 16 fps.
promptGuide: Describe the person and how they talk, in one or two short sentences: mood, head and hand movement, camera (static or slow push in). Do not describe the words; they come from the voice.
